Molstar viewer assets
=====================

This directory vendors the Molstar viewer JavaScript and CSS bundle used by
the RMSX Molstar Flipbook notebook/HTML renderer.

Package: molstar
Version: 5.4.2
Project: https://molstar.org/
Source package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/molstar/v/5.4.2
Repository: https://github.com/molstar/molstar

The generated JavaScript bundle includes bundled third-party license notices
near the end of molstar.js. The CSS bundle includes its own inline source
license notice where provided by the upstream build.
